about: Reviewed coordinate-like decimals that are NOT true coordinates (T-090, D-106). scripts/check-images.mjs (rule C1) fails on every other coordinate-like value (a decimal with 4+ significant fraction digits and an integer part of 0-180, a decimal comma, DMS with seconds or decimal minutes, the XMP GPS form), in any file a commit could take, outside web/public/samples/*.json, shared/testvectors/*.json and the repo's lock files (D-119). Exactly one entry per file: exact values as written (sign included) and a why of at least 20 characters. Add a value only after checking it is synthetic (prefer the open-ocean test area near 0.5, -30.5), a public reference point, or not a coordinate at all, and say why. A value no longer in its file prints a warning: remove it.
